snippet.title: Defaced: Dark Abyss | Announcement Trailer | 2024 Horror Game
snippet.description:
🔦 Get ready to embark on a chilling journey into the unknown!
Defaced: Dark Abyss is a first-person horror adventure game. While exploring a seemingly normal cave, you will soon realize that, hidden in the depths, lurks something you were never meant to see...

🗓️ Stay tuned for more updates, including the release date and how you can be among the first to play the FREE DEMO.
Don't forget to subscribe and turn on notifications so you won't miss a thing!
